title: Code-graph hardening + selective navigation routing guidance (D-005 amendment 2)
objective: Apply the four owner-mandated hardening items to tools/code_graph (hash-bind graph.json in meta with verify-on-load regenerate/refuse; cache identity beyond basename; safe cache/meta read-error handling; preserve stdlib-only/no-network/no-hook/no-product-runtime-dependency) plus the review-identified --limit subcommand-position fix, and add ONLY the minimal SELECTIVE routing guidance from the accepted decision packet: a CLAUDE.md routing-table mention and a start-controlled-task packet-guidance paragraph encoding the owner decision model (relationship/dependency discovery materially useful? YES: graph then narrow then source verification; NO: normal direct navigation), with the owner's SHOULD-prefer and NOT-mandatory case lists. No new graph platform, no reserved surfaces, no watchers/hooks, no universal graph-first.
business_reason: Owner decision on the M0-T030 packet (D-005 amendment 2): GO WITH CONDITIONS - preserve the proven correctness gain without imposing graph overhead on easy tasks; close the independent-review hardening advisories before wider advisory use.
inputs: project-control/directives/D-005-codebase-knowledge-graph-pilot/source-003-amendment.md (owner GO WITH CONDITIONS + eight clarifications; rows D-005-R090..R110)
project-control/reports/M0-T030-owner-decision-packet.md (accepted; section H = the ONLY routing surfaces authorized, now selective)
project-control/reports/M0-T030-G5-security.md (advisories: hash-bind graph.json LOW; cache-key INFO; OSError INFO) and M0-T030-G3-code-review.md / M0-T030-G4-qa.md (--limit position INFO)
tools/context_budget_check.py (CLAUDE.md addition must keep the budget check PASS)
outputs: tools/code_graph/generate.py + query.py: sha256(graph.json) recorded in graph.meta.json and verified on load (mismatch/corruption -> regenerate, or refuse with explicit error under --no-regen; NEVER silently serve altered cache); cache dir keyed by repo-root path hash + basename; cache/meta read errors (OSError/ValueError) handled as stale->regenerate/refuse, no avoidable traceback; --limit accepted after subcommands as well as before; generator_version bump

tools/test_code_graph.py: new fixture tests for tamper-detection (edit cached graph.json -> not served), cache-key separation of same-named checkouts, unreadable/corrupt meta handling, --limit both positions; all existing invariants stay green

tools/code_graph/README.md: SELECTIVE routing section encoding the owner decision model verbatim-faithfully (graph-preferred list; not-mandatory list; never universal graph-first; no token/time-savings claims)
CLAUDE.md: ONE additive routing-table row pointing dependency/impact/trace questions at tools/code_graph/README.md (context_budget_check must remain PASS)

.claude/skills/start-controlled-task/SKILL.md: ONE additive paragraph of packet navigation guidance (selective decision model, advisory-only, source verification mandatory) - the 'task-packet template paragraph' contemplated by the accepted packet
allowed_paths: CLAUDE.md (ONE additive routing-table row only; context budget check must stay PASS)
forbidden_paths: .claude/settings.json, .claude/hooks/**, .claude/agents/**, .claude/rules/** and every other .claude surface except the single SKILL.md paragraph above (D-005-R105/R107)
services/**, apps/**, packages/**, supabase/** (no product changes; no product runtime dependency, D-005-R094-c4)
requirements*, package*.json, pyproject.toml - no dependencies (stdlib only)
ci.yml and all workflows (existing code-graph CI job already covers the tests; no CI change needed - if the producer believes one is needed, STOP and report)
Mission Control, layer-B graph, six-PRD, evidence-KG, Graphify, Agent-Teams injection surfaces (D-005-R109)
Any universal graph-first wording: routing guidance must be selective (D-005-R092/R096)
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (executable): tamper test - generate into a temp cache, flip one byte in graph.json, query WITHOUT source changes: the CLI regenerates (or refuses with explicit error under --no-regen); the altered graph is never served; a fixture test proves it.

AS-2 (executable): meta corruption/unreadable test - truncate/corrupt graph.meta.json (and simulate an OSError path where practical): query treats it as stale (regenerate/refuse), no traceback leaks; fixture test proves it.

AS-3 (executable): cache identity - two same-named fixture repos at different paths get DISTINCT cache dirs; fixture test proves no sharing; fingerprint gate still prevents any stale serve regardless.
AS-4 (executable): --limit works both before and after the subcommand; existing 40-default/200-hard-cap behavior unchanged; test proves both positions.

AS-5 (executable): python tools/test_code_graph.py exits 0 with all prior invariants (determinism, non-self-referential fingerprint incl. tsconfig, sentinel exclusions, honesty labels, no caller/callee, stdlib-only imports) still green plus the new tests.
AS-6 (executable): python tools/code_graph/generate.py --repo . --check PASS; python tools/context_budget_check.py PASS with the CLAUDE.md row added.

AS-7 (evidence): CLAUDE.md diff = exactly one additive routing-table row; SKILL.md diff = exactly one additive paragraph; both encode SELECTIVE routing (decision model + SHOULD-prefer + NOT-mandatory lists faithful to source-003 clarification 2), advisory-only language, and NO token/time-savings claim (D-005-R101).
AS-8 (evidence): README selective-routing section faithful to the owner decision model; grep proves no 'graph-first for every task' style wording anywhere in the diff.
AS-9 (evidence): task-branch diff touches only allowed paths; no hooks/watchers/config/product/dependency surfaces; existing CI jobs byte-untouched.
risks: CLAUDE.md is auto-loaded context guarded by tools/context_budget_check.py - the added row must keep the check PASS or the producer must STOP and report (no trimming of other CLAUDE.md content without owner approval).
SKILL.md guidance must not read as mandatory graph use anywhere (owner clarification 2).
Hash-bind changes meta semantics - generator_version bump required; determinism invariants must stay byte-stable.
Windows CRLF byte-identity discipline unchanged (LF-only artifact writes).
allowed_paths_note: The two guidance surfaces are exactly the ones the accepted decision packet contemplated (section H), adjusted to SELECTIVE routing per amendment-2 clarification 2. The SKILL.md edit is additive prose guidance only - NOT a hook, NOT a config change, NOT a confinement change; G5 must verify the diff is a single additive paragraph.
